Definition: from G2532 and G1565; likewise that (or those):--and him (other, them), even he, him also, them (also), (and) they.
BiblicalUsage: Kakeinos is 'that one also' — the same person or thing, and yet more. The works that I do shall he do also; Father, I will that they also, whom Thou hast given me, be with me where I am; and they also, if they abide not still in unbelief, shall be grafted in.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that this word is the gospel's 'also': the same works, the same presence, the same grafting — what Christ has, His people share, and what Israel lost, the grafted branch can still receive.
